Chapter 6658: A Statue

Chapter 6658: A Statue

Anyone else would have been viewed as being arrogant or deceitful. After all, the situation was dramatically unfavorable for Life and Death Heaven.

Its lord’s fate remained unknown due to the incoming tribulation. Moreover, Desolate Ancestor was absent, leaving Supreme Black Ancestor behind to steer the ship.

However, he could only handle Weizhen. Primal Yin Immortal Ghost was an overlord, not to mention an immortal in Bao Pu.

In reality, Bao Pu alone could decide the outcome of this battle. His original plan of ambushing her would have been perfect. This made her advice puzzling.

Everyone contemplated in silence since they believed her. What other ace cards did she have up her sleeve?

Nevertheless, Bao Pu and the ghost came prepared. Everything has been going according to plan and victory was theirs.

“I appreciate the kind intent, which is why I am here in the open. Focus on your tribulation first.” Bao Pu said.

The two wanted to stay hidden, but something about her words made them reveal themselves. Perhaps they recalled their youth when they were honorable and cared about face.

Hiding in the shadows for too long changed them. Her sincerity caused them to change their tactic.

“Yes, I’m afraid I can’t keep you company for too long, Senior and Luminous Master.” She said.

“It would have been a pleasure to fight you, Your Majesty. I hope you can become an immortal.” The ghost said before walking into the gate.

This sounded absurd because these ambushers were giving her their blessing now.

“I will wait until the tribulation to kill you, I hope you will survive.” Bao Pu said.

He didn’t hide his intention at all. Moreover, an immortal should have an easy time killing an overlord. Nevertheless, he still wanted to wait until she was at her weakest.

Everyone worried for her sake since they couldn’t see a way out.

At this time, the ghost had entered while Bao Pu still stood outside the gate.

“Luminous Master, please stop.” The lord spoke again.

The ghost laughed and said: “Your Majesty, this day is just as pivotal for me as it is for you. It is when I shall become an immortal. There is no turning back, regardless of what challenges await me.”

He found courage and high spirit again, no longer hiding and scheming. He stated his ambition and was ready to die.

“A hint of his old self.” A few ancient ancestors commented after seeing the ghost entering Life and Death Heaven through the front gate.

“Rumble!” A statue pulsing with light somehow blocked his path.

No matter how powerful it may be, it couldn't possibly stop an overlord. This applied even to the statue of an immortal.

Upon closer inspection, everyone noticed how remarkably lifelike it was - a breathtaking beauty in a green dress. She resembled a lotus in a secluded valley. Her long hair draped over her shoulders; they were carved from stone yet still emitted a vivid imagery of flowing with the wind. She looked ethereal and graceful like no other.

Her eyes appeared to be alive, dazzling like divine orbs. They could captivate anyone who saw her for the first time.

“...” The crowd was left speechless. If the statue were moving, some might mistake it for a living person.

“Guardian Blade of Life and Death.” Godstallion recognized her.
